# solidping_status_page (Data Source)

Look up an existing status page by `uid` or by `slug`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "solidping_status_page" "public" {
  slug = "acme"
}

resource "solidping_status_page_section" "extra" {
  status_page_uid = data.solidping_status_page.public.id
  name            = "Extra"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `slug` (String) Slug of the status page. Exactly one of `uid` and `slug` must be set.
- `uid` (String) UID of the status page. Exactly one of `uid` and `slug` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `custom_domain` (String) Hostname the page is served on, empty when none.
- `description` (String) Text shown under the title.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the page is served.
- `id` (String) UID of the status page.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default status page of the organization.
- `name` (String) Title of the page.
- `visibility` (String) `public`, `private` or `password`.
